I’m Xiraiya — a 21-year-old developer from Rajshahi, Bangladesh. I started coding as a teenager and got hooked on making things people actually use.

For 5+ years I’ve built software that businesses run on every day. Shops that take payments at 3 AM. Telegram bots that answer customers while the owner sleeps. Chrome extensions, Minecraft plugins, installable apps, and AI agents that handle sales and support without a babysitter.

You deal with one person from the first Figma frame to launch day. The server, the payment webhook and the bug at midnight are all mine.

便 Reader questions · 読者のお便り

You asked. The sage answers.

Reader #103How much does a website cost?

A landing page is $50–70. A normal shop is $100–150, and an automated shop with an AI agent and auto payments is $150–300. Telegram bots run $50–100, or $150–400 for a custom one. More requirements, more money, but you always get a fixed quote first.

Reader #120How fast can you deliver?

Small builds in 3 to 7 days. Bigger ones get milestones, and you see a working preview every day.

Reader #137Can you take bKash, Nagad or crypto?

Yes. bKash, Nagad, cards, USDT, BTC and cash on delivery, with payments that confirm themselves.

Reader #154Do I own the code?

Completely. You get the source, the docs and the logins. No lock-in, no monthly fee to me.

Reader #171What if something breaks after launch?

Bug fixes are free during the support window (7 to 60 days, depending on the package). After that, maintenance is optional.

Reader #188I only have an idea. Is that enough?

That is how most projects start. Send it over and I will turn it into a plan with a price, usually within a few hours.
